completion_requirements.authoritative_evidence: The manuscript introduction proves the complementary-face rank identity and lattice-translation deletion law, credits known duality, and connects them to the finite face-information problem. Exact occurrence and prime-stream controls are preserved.

Manuscript Lemmas 2-4 and Theorems 5, 7 and 1 give uniform lower and upper bounds, both parities, exact face-parameter equality, finite prime transfer and the second logarithmic term. The complete proofs were checked step by step, including strict and zero-variance cases.

The older corner-cut manuscript counts prefixes and cuts for each fixed dimension; the older pyramidal manuscript studies containment/Mobius structure. Both are byte-preserved. The new result optimizes the support/rank relation over growing dimension and has a different quantitative statement and proof.

Theorem 8 supplies exact support bounds for a realizable prefix cone and box certificates containing rigorous prime-log intervals. The checker validates 16 prime-prefix certificates against independent exact product and pointer generators. This reads the prefix and border; no speedup is claimed.

Corollary 9 identifies the same exact parameter for sufficiently generic point-ideal state fans over C. Published identification is credited; padding proves optimality at every prescribed size. Proposition 10 delimits the arbitrary-quotient extension.

The research replay, core build and smoke passed at the current sources. Previous certificates are preserved; 21 additional boundary cases pass. Terminal and desktop LaTeX compilation succeeded; all eight final PDF pages were rendered and inspected.

Thirteen named primary comparisons and exact reading scopes are recorded. Standard tools and direct published corollaries are excluded from the claimed delta. The inspected statements leave a defensible scoped originality case, not an assertion of globally established priority.

The final internal decision is to retain a focused specialist-paper contribution and provide the complete anonymous manuscript for independent review. Significance is structural and quantitative. Authorship, submission, acceptance and independent priority/correctness adjudication are not claimed.

All 235 other tracked files, 25 prior checker functions, old report blocks, the entire earlier note prefix and six historical goal iterations are preserved. Only the listed eight research files are selected for publication; private source caches and audit records remain ignored. No messages, outreach or submission were performed.
